content:
Jia: Heads-up — after the console rollout at ~12:33 PDT we started seeing a large spike in client-side cooldowns and resume attempts for streaming responses. Console shows a sharp bump in resume_count and proxy 5xxs. Rolling back the UI change for now. @Samir @Devon

ops-bot: deploy started by console-rollout/2026-03-20 12:30:12 (canary -> 25%) :information_source:

deploy-bot: rollback initiated for console-rollout/2026-03-20 12:38:09 :white_check_mark:

Samir: Ack. Seeing matching errors in proxy logs: lots of "heartbeat missing" and immediate connection closes. My initial hunch: the UI change is batching heartbeat suppression when a tab goes backgrounded, but we didn't account for our proxy keepalive window.

Devon: Can you paste the log snippet?

Samir: 
```
[12:33:41] proxy: conn_id=0xabc drop reason=heartbeat_missed last_rx=12:33:35
[12:33:42] ws-handler: conn_id=0xabc ack timeout=10002ms closing
[12:33:42] console-proxy: resume_attempt route=stream/v1 count=7
[12:33:42] metrics: emit resume_count=1 route=all
```

Jia: Important note: the console change intentionally suppressed some heartbeat pings when a tab was backgrounded to reduce noise. But the suppression dropped below proxy's grace period (10s) for many clients, so proxy considered them dead and issued reconnects which then hit quota/backoff logic.

Devon: Two immediate problems: (1) telemetry is aggregated at route=all so we couldn't detect which routes/populations were affected, (2) console rollout ID wasn't tagged in resume metrics so correlation is hard.

Samir: Proposal: revert UI change (done), add rollout tag to resume/heartbeat telemetry, and instrument per-route resume_count. Also increase proxy grace window to 12s temporarily to avoid churn during rollouts. Thoughts?

Jia: +1 to tagging. We should also add server-side jitter to accept slight heartbeat gaps instead of immediate close — maybe N consecutive missed heartbeats rather than single. That buys us resilience for mobile/backgrounded clients.

Devon: For the console UX, we can flip to a gentler suppression: only stop heartbeat if tab is backgrounded for >30s, otherwise keep sending. That aligns with common browser behavior. We'll open PR.

Samir: I'll push a quick metrics patch: add labels rollout_id and route for resume_count and heartbeat_miss. Query will be something like: sum by (route, rollout_id) (increase(resume_count[5m])). Will add to dashboards.

Jia: Also: add an alert that fires when resume_rate > 0.5% of active connections for a route over 5m — that would've caught this earlier. Can we add as a temporary ramp for the rollout?

Devon: Yep, will add alert to canary dashboard and wire it to the rollout automation to halt at threshold.

ops-bot: Note: created ticket INC-3456 for postmortem and follow-ups (link: https://tickets.internal/INC-3456)

Samir: Action items I have: 1) temp proxy grace bump (ops) 2) metrics labels + dashboard update (PR #678) 3) add N-missed-heartbeats tolerance in proxy (proto PR #679) 4) revert is live.

Devon: I'll open console PR to soften suppression and include a small client-side jitter for reconnection backoff. PR #680.

Jia: Can we also add a small note in the console rollout UX: "Streaming may temporarily disconnect during experimental rollouts" so support gets fewer pages?

console-ux: I'll add the snackbar copy and the rollout-facing checkbox to opt-out of suppression for internal orgs.

Samir: Quick check: last_message_ts set to 2205009300 to capture ops follow-up.

Jia: Thanks everyone. Let's watch the dashboards for the next 30m and circle for a short postmortem doc in INC-3456. :thumbsup:
